name: Kelly Simone
residence: Park County (Cody Enterprise, Sept. 21, 2022, identified her in a Cody-area hospital-district campaign)
occupation: Park County commissioner (official commissioners page). A September 21, 2022, Cody Enterprise profile of her West Park Hospital District campaign reported that she had served as a physician assistant at Cody Regional Health for 18 years, had recently been hired at Billings Clinic, and had 21 years of experience as a physician assistant, including work in Driggs, Idaho, and Greybull.
prior_offices: Park County commissioner (elected November 2024). The 2022 Cody Enterprise article reported prior service on a school board.
background: Kelly Simone is a Park County commissioner, elected in the November 2024 general election. The official commissioners page lists her on the board. In a September 21, 2022, Cody Enterprise article about her campaign for the West Park Hospital District board, the paper reported that she had served as a physician assistant at Cody Regional Health for 18 years, had recently been hired at Billings Clinic, had 21 years of experience as a physician assistant including work in Driggs, Idaho, and Greybull, and that she had previously served on a school board.
